name: Deep Blue Resolve
descriptionTemplate: While commanding ship units, there is a X% chance to deal a critical attack when attacking or launching airstrikes. (If the general has this skill, the effects of Fleet Leader and Airforce Leader are inapplicable.)

progression.renderedDesc: While commanding ship units, there is a 16% chance to deal a critical attack when attacking or launching airstrikes. (If the general has this skill, the effects of Fleet Leader and Airforce Leader are inapplicable.)
progression.renderedDescFr: Lorsque vous commandez des navires, 16% de chances d'infliger une attaque critique en attaquant ou en lançant des frappes aériennes. (Si le général possède cette compétence, les effets de Chef de flotte et Chef de l'aviation ne s'appliquent pas.)
progression.renderedDescDe: Beim Befehligen von Schiffseinheiten besteht eine 16% Chance auf einen kritischen Treffer bei Angriffen oder Luftschlägen. (Besitzt der General diese Fähigkeit, sind die Effekte von Flottenführer und Luftwaffenführer unwirksam.)

longDesc: Compétence spécifique à un général. « Résolution de l'abysse » monte jusqu'au niveau 5. Au niveau maximum (5), elle applique l'effet suivant : « While commanding unités navales, there is a 80% chance to deal a attaques critiques lors d'une attaque or launching airstrikes. (If the general has this skill, the effects of Fleet Leader and aviation Leader are inapplicable.) ». Signature de carte — impossible à remplacer, définit souvent l'identité tactique du général.
longDescEn: A general-specific skill. "Deep Blue Resolve" scales up to level 5. At max level (5), the skill applies the following effect: "While commanding ship units, there is a 80% chance to deal a critical attack when attacking or launching airstrikes. (If the general has this skill, the effects of Fleet Leader and Airforce Leader are inapplicable.)". A card signature — cannot be swapped; it often defines the general's tactical identity.
longDescDe: Eine generalspezifische Fähigkeit. „Deep Blue Resolve“ skaliert bis Stufe 5. Auf Maximalstufe (5) wirkt folgender Effekt: „While commanding ship units, there is a 80% chance to deal a critical attack when attacking or launching airstrikes. (If the general has this skill, the effects of Fleet Leader and Airforce Leader are inapplicable.)“. Eine Karten-Signatur — nicht austauschbar, prägt oft die taktische Identität des Generals.
